requests.name: Browse Pets (public, no login)
requests.description: Public since the backlog batch (2026-09-19). Anonymous callers ONLY ever see AVAILABLE pets - a status filter for other statuses is ignored. Logged-in users see all statuses as before. Filters/sort/paging work as documented on 'Get All Pets'. Do NOT send an expired/garbage Authorization header: it returns 401 even on public routes.

requests.name: Get Pet by Id (public, no login)
requests.description: Public. Returns 404 for a pet that is not AVAILABLE when the caller is anonymous (same answer as a missing pet). /api/pets/{id}/medical-records and every other sub-route stay protected.

requests.name: Browse Shelters (public, no login)
requests.description: Public. Paginated list with optional ?name= search.

requests.name: Get Shelter by Id (public, no login)
requests.description: Public.

requests.name: Forgot Password
requests.description: Always returns the same generic success message, whether or not the email is registered - avoids leaking which emails exist. The actual reset token is emailed to the user (check the local dev DB's password_reset_tokens table if no real mailbox is configured).

requests.name: Reset Password
requests.description: Token is single-use and expires 1 hour after Forgot Password was called.

requests.name: Get My Profile
requests.description: Works for any authenticated role, not just adopters - swap the token to test as shelter admin/staff/system admin.

requests.name: Get My Notifications
requests.description: Works for any authenticated role - swap the token to test as any user.

requests.name: Mark Notification as Read
requests.description: Fails if the notification does not belong to the caller.

requests.name: Assign Shelter to User
requests.description: Links a shelter staff/admin account to a shelter (System Admin only). Pass "shelterId": null to unassign. A SHELTER_ADMIN must be assigned before they can create pets - the pet's shelter is derived from this link, never client-supplied.

requests.name: Edit Pet by Id
requests.description: Since 2026-09-19: a SHELTER_ADMIN can only change pets of their OWN shelter (400 otherwise); SYSTEM_ADMIN may also use this (needed for legacy pets with no shelter).

requests.name: Delete Pet by Id
requests.description: Since 2026-09-19: a SHELTER_ADMIN can only change pets of their OWN shelter (400 otherwise); SYSTEM_ADMIN may also use this (needed for legacy pets with no shelter). Deleting a pet that has medical records is refused (400).

requests.name: Upload Pet Image
requests.description: Uploads (or replaces) the pet's photo via Cloudinary. Select a file for the 'file' form field before sending.

requests.name: Add Pet Gallery Image
requests.description: Appends a gallery photo without replacing the main image. Select a file for the 'file' form field before sending. BREAKING (2026-09-19): PetResponseDto.imageUrls (list of strings) is now images: [{id, url}] so single images can be replaced/deleted by id.

requests.name: Replace Pet Gallery Image
requests.description: Replaces ONE gallery image (multipart 'file'), keeping its id; the old Cloudinary file is deleted. Own shelter only; the image must belong to the pet in the URL. Image ids come from PetResponseDto.images[].id.

requests.name: Delete Pet Gallery Image
requests.description: Deletes ONE gallery image (row + Cloudinary file). Own shelter only. Deleting a whole pet now also cleans up its gallery.

requests.name: Approve Adoption Application by Id
requests.description: Body is optional. "notes" becomes the application's reviewNotes.

requests.name: Reject Adoption Application by Id
requests.description: Body is optional. "notes" becomes the application's rejectionReason.

requests.name: Get My Slots

requests.description: Shelter Admin/Staff (own shelter) or System Admin only.

Create Appointment
requests.description: Book an appointment for an open slot (pick slotId from "Browse Open Slots for Shelter"). shelterId is derived from the slot, not client-supplied.

requests.name: Ping (LLM smoke test)
requests.description: Phase 1: bare LLM connectivity check - no RAG, no tools yet. Works for any authenticated role.

requests.name: Ingest RAG Documents
requests.description: Phase 2: (re)ingests the curated markdown docs in src/main/resources/ai-docs into pgvector. Hash-idempotent - re-running with no doc changes returns SKIPPED_UNCHANGED for everything. System Admin only.

requests.name: Pet Care Chat (RAG)
requests.description: Phase 2: Pet Care Advisor, grounded in the ingested docs via QuestionAnswerAdvisor. Run 'Ingest RAG Documents' at least once first.

requests.name: Pet Matching Chat
requests.description: Phase 3b: Pet Matching Agent - searches only AVAILABLE pets (species/energyLevel/temperament/free-text) and remembers the last 20 messages per user (conversation ID = your own email), so follow-up questions like 'what was her breed again?' work without repeating context.

requests.name: Adoption Advisor Chat
requests.description: Phase 4: Adoption Advisor - reports ONLY the caller's own application status (the tool takes no id argument; identity comes from the JWT) and answers process/fees/requirements questions from the RAG docs. Run 'Ingest RAG Documents' at least once first. Read-only: it never submits or changes anything.

requests.name: Coordinator Chat (single entrypoint)
requests.description: Phase 5a/5b: one entrypoint with real orchestration. A planner (no tools, no memory) makes an ordered plan of 1-3 advisor steps (MATCHING, CARE, ADOPTION, each at most once). Steps run in order and later steps see earlier answers (e.g. matched pet -> its fee), then one reply is merged. If a step fails the rest still answer and the reply says which part could not be answered; if all fail -> 503. Vague messages get a clarifying question. Try: 'Find me a calm dog for my apartment and tell me the adoption fee for it'.

requests.name: Clear My AI Chat History
requests.description: Erases the CALLER's own stored AI conversations (all advisors). Identity comes from the JWT. Inactive conversations are also purged automatically after app.ai.memory.retention-days (default 30) by a job on app.ai.memory.purge-cron (default daily 03:00).
